dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: "Of all the martial faculties in the world, speed reigns supreme"!

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: Do you not know? This is called the Dance of the Frenzied Turtle!

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: Check it out — was that fast or what!?

response.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
response.text: Hmph, your mind can't believe your eyes, that's all!

response.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
response.text: The reason you didn't see it is that I was too fast for you! Now is that fast or what!?

choices.text: Does this have any practical applications?

response.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
response.text: Whether it does or not, it is right to practice it! I am not merely learning a martial art form — I am heeding divine guidance in pursuit of the Way!

response.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
response.text: All in all, I've spent tens of thousands of Mora on this! As long as I practice it, it'll all be worth it. Right!?
